tickets.summary: K-3401 non-drive-end bearing vibration rose from 2.1 to 4.6 mm/s in six weeks, with growing 1x/sidebands and no plateau, threatening the sole gas-export train despite remaining below alarm.
tickets.recommended_action: Today, rotating equipment specialist: repeat spectrum/inspect bearing; disposition/correct; verify stable below alarm; trend daily. Check containment/personnel exposure. Confirm export output and trip status. Obtain source-required attention today. Repeat spectrum; inspect bearing.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Vibration more than doubled over six weeks, with a growing 1x component, sidebands and no plateau. This is strong progression, but it remains below alarm and function loss is not confirmed.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this sole gas-export compressor has no spare or workaround and would send the platform to recycle and cut production within an hour, supporting severe operational impact.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first weekly test start, then started after about 8 s; 22.8 V batteries and recurrent battery/starting-air issues indicate possible starting-system degradation despite rated pressure.
tickets.recommended_action: Fire-protection authority: inspect batteries, start circuit and air; repair as found, then retest first-demand start and rated pressure. Check impairment deviation record. Load-test batteries; check starting air. Retest first-demand start and rated pressure. Test FW-8101 pressure and flow.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: An actual function test confirmed failure to start on the first attempt. Subsequent starting and rated pressure show hydraulic capability remained, but do not negate the demonstrated demand-start failure; recurring starting problems further support the top likelihood band.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure removes one safety-critical firewater-pump leg. FW-8101 cannot be credited as fully capable because its later test reached 9.2 barg versus 11 barg without measured flow. This supports severe protection degradation, but total firewater loss is not established.

tickets.summary: Survey found wet-insulation corrosion at window 2 by the low-point drain: 6.2 mm wall versus 7.4 mm minimum on a full-wellhead-pressure hydrocarbon flowline.
tickets.recommended_action: Extend UT; integrity engineer set FFS-based operating/repair disposition; repair and verify ≥7.4 mm. Check release and personnel exposure. Complete FFS and set operating limits. Confirm leak status and containment. Map CUI extent at low-point drain.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The 6.2 mm wall is below the 7.4 mm minimum at wet, heavily scaled insulation, indicating advanced localized damage and an active CUI threat. No confirmed leak or imminent loss supports a top-band score.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Containment failure could release hydrocarbon at full wellhead pressure from a nonredundant production flowline, creating severe process and personnel exposure. Details needed to support an extreme consequence are unavailable.

tickets.summary: Compression-module FG-0455 head twice failed to respond to 50% LEL gas; the other two 2oo3 heads passed, leaving detection available with one failed channel and lost voting margin.
tickets.recommended_action: Instrument engineering authority: diagnose and repair/replace as found; prove response to 50% LEL gas. Bump-test all 3 detector heads. Check impairment/deviation record. Diagnose failed head.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Repeated nonresponse with a second gas cylinder confirms that this detector head cannot perform its required function. The wider voted arrangement does not reduce the failed head's likelihood.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of one SCE hydrocarbon detector channel moderately degrades protection. The other two heads responded in the 2oo3 group, preserving voted capability but removing failure margin.

tickets.summary: CR-5001 main-hoist rope has 6 broken wires/lay versus 10 discard at the maximum-radius drum-spooling section, with poor lubrication; progression could impair load support and stop supply-boat offloads.
tickets.recommended_action: Certifying lifting authority inspect full rope, set service/repair disposition, lubricate as directed, and re-survey to 10-wire criterion. Confirm certificate and service disposition. Inspect full rope and recount wires. Review lift and personnel exposure.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Six broken wires and poor lubrication show limited degradation, but the count remains below the 10-wire discard criterion and no progression or operational loss is reported.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of safe main-hoist load support could drop a suspended load; the non-redundant crane would also become unavailable, stopping supply-boat offloads and creating logistics problems within days. Personnel exposure remains unknown.

tickets.summary: P-3305 tripped three times this month, leaving wellhead-manifold inhibitor injection intermittent for around 10 days; diaphragm failure is suspected, and starvation can initiate downstream corrosion within weeks.
tickets.recommended_action: Diagnose pump/line; correct findings per corrosion engineer and test for continuous, trip-free injection. Check impairment/deviation records. Confirm continuous injection restored. Confirm downstream inventory and exposure. Inspect diaphragm and injection system.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Three low-pressure trips in one month and approximately ten days of intermittent injection directly establish recurrent loss of the pump's required function.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Without redundancy, loss of inhibitor injection can begin downstream carbon-steel corrosion within weeks and create a delayed integrity consequence, although immediate production loss is not expected.

tickets.summary: PSV-3420's certification tag is illegible from corrosion, but March 2025 recertification remains in date and the valve appears sound; this is a traceability defect, not demonstrated relief impairment.
tickets.recommended_action: Authorized PSV certifier: verify valve/register identity, replace the tag, and confirm legibility and register match. Confirm scenario and personnel exposure.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Only the certification tag is defective. The valve is in date, appears physically sound and is reported as behaving itself, providing little indication of near-term relief-function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this sole SCE PSV would remove compressor-discharge overpressure protection. With no redundancy, this supports severe major-accident exposure, but the supplied scenario detail does not justify the extreme band.

tickets.summary: FW-8101 started, but stabilised at 9.2 barg versus 11 barg design; flow was unmeasured, so output is degraded and pump wear or a restricted test-line valve remains suspected.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect pump/test-line valves; fire-protection authority to disposition, correct and retest duty. Check fire demand and exposure. Check/record protection deviation. Test FW-8102 start and capacity. Test pressure/flow to criteria.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The measured pressure shortfall demonstrates meaningful degradation, but the pump started first time, engine parameters were normal, flow was unmeasured and no progression or repeat is supplied. This supports active degradation, not confirmed function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure would remove one of two safety-critical firewater pumps and degrade fire protection. The linked partner had an earlier first-attempt start failure and its current capability is unverified, so redundancy is neither credited nor assumed failed; both pumps unavailable requires production shutdown.

tickets.summary: K-3401’s second-stage discharge-line cladding was reported loose and flapping in wind, with detachment as a dropped-object hazard if left; no process concern was reported.
tickets.recommended_action: Rotating-equipment specialist inspect cladding/supports today; control drop zone, secure/replace as found, and verify retention. Check drop height, mass and exposure. Inspect current cladding condition. Obtain source-required attention today.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Loose cladding is already flapping under wind loading and is explicitly expected to become a dropped object if left, supporting strong progression short of confirmed detachment.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Detachment creates a credible dropped-object injury hazard. No process concern is reported, while mass, drop height and personnel exposure are unknown, supporting only a material personnel-consequence band.
